record.bible_text: I will stand<WH05975><WTH8799> upon my watch<WH04931>, and set<WH03320><WTH8691> me upon the tower<WH04692>, and will watch<WH06822><WTH8762> to see<WH07200><WTH8800> what he will say<WH01696><WTH8762> unto me, and what I shall answer<WH07725><WTH8686> when I am reproved<WH08433>. <RF>tower: Heb. fenced place<Rf> <RF>unto me: or, in me<Rf> <RF>when...: or, when I am argued with: Heb. upon my reproof, or, arguing<Rf>

Because thou hast spoiled<WH07997><WTH8804> many<WH07227> nations<WH01471>, all the remnant<WH03499> of the people<WH05971> shall spoil<WH07997><WTH8799> thee; because of men's<WH0120> blood<WH01818>, and <FI>for<Fi> the violence<WH02555> of the land<WH0776>, of the city<WH07151>, and of all that dwell<WH03427><WTH8802> therein. <RF>blood: Heb. bloods<Rf>
